slide1.headline: EU AI Act Simplified
slide1.subtitle: Unpacking the AI Omnibus Agreement of May 2026

slide2.title: WHAT HAPPENED
lines: The EU AI Act was simplified through the AI Omnibus Agreement
The agreement aims to regulate the development and use of AI in the EU
The regulation will apply to companies that develop and use AI models
The agreement was announced in May 2026

slide3.title: INSIGHTS
bullets: The EU AI Act aims to ensure that AI is developed and used in a way that is transparent and accountable
The regulation will help to build trust in AI systems
The agreement is a significant step forward for the EU's AI strategy
Source: Mishcon de Reya LLP, 28 May 2026
